newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs recover to close virtually unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs recover to close virtually unchanged.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Investor demand after a small monthly OLO auction helped linear bond futures recover from opening losses to close virtually unchanged. They had fallen up to 43 bp in early trade. *2006 OLO 6.65% BE283=, 27 bps over Bunds (26) MEUR ; *OLO fut -1 at 116.01 BGBc1 ; DEMBEF= 20.5915/30 (20.58) *3-mo bill 3.07/12%; 1-wk repo 3.02/04
